description: This file provides polyfill implementations for certain functions in the torch._C._nn module, including argument parsing for nn.Module.to(), checking module parameter conversion, and tensor type compatibility. It uses decorators to substitute functions in the torch codebase.

methods.name: _parse_to_polyfill
methods.description: Polyfill for argument parsing in torch._C._nn._parse_to, handling various input types and returning device, dtype, non_blocking, and memory_format.

methods.name: get_swap_module_params_on_conversion_polyfill
methods.description: Polyfill that returns the value of torch.__future__.get_swap_module_params_on_conversion.

methods.name: _has_compatible_shallow_copy_type_polyfill
methods.description: Polyfill that checks if two tensors have compatible shallow copy types by comparing their Python types.
